steps.dump: (() => { const lm = document.querySelector('[data-testid=diorama-loot-moment]'); const plate = document.querySelector('[data-testid=primary-diorama-target-hp]'); const sig = document.querySelector('[data-testid=pixel-enemy-signature]'); return JSON.stringify({ lootMoment: !!lm, plate: plate ? plate.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() : null, enemySig: !!sig }); })()
steps.eval: (() => { window.__holdTrace = []; const t0 = performance.now(); const iv = setInterval(() => { const lm = document.querySelector('[data-testid=diorama-loot-moment]'); const plate = document.querySelector('[data-testid=primary-diorama-target-hp]'); const sig = document.querySelector('[data-testid=pixel-enemy-signature]'); window.__holdTrace.push({ t: Math.round(performance.now() - t0), lm: !!lm, plate: plate ? plate.textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim() : null, sig: !!sig }); if (window.__holdTrace.length >= 30) clearInterval(iv); }, 200); })(); window.__seedGearDrop && window.__seedGearDrop()
